title: Mutation Intent
description:
Internal schema used by the soc_autonomous_applier workflow. The meta-agent emits a mutation_intent for every change it wants to make to an ARGUS-managed artifact (registry owner=autosoc); the soc_autonomous_applier workflow runs deterministic governance gates (kill-switch, ownership, budget, cooldown, loop-detection, trust-tier, drift, backtest) against this shape, then dispatches the validated intent to soc_autonomous_applier-agent for snapshot + tool-based execution.

Conditional rules:
  - artifact_type='rule' AND op='update' -> `details.patch` MUST conform to rule_patch.schema.json#/properties/details. Prose-only patches are rejected at ingest and routed to .soc-dead-letter.
  - Creates/updates of non-rule artifacts -> either `new_definition` or `patch` is required.

expected_ownership.description: What the meta-agent believes the artifact's owner is. The applier verifies against the registry before mutating.

new_definition.description: Required for op=create|update on non-rule artifacts. The full artifact definition the applier will PUT.

patch.description: Partial definition for op=update. For rule artifacts this MUST conform to rule_patch.schema.json (patch_fields + current_values + impact_prediction). Applier merges with current state.

preview_rule.description: For rule/op=update: post-merge rule the backtester will project against. Agent computes this so the backtester doesn't need to re-apply the patch logic.
